limits.en: 1,000 credits, 1 concurrent browser, no credit card required.

keyLimits.en: 30,000 credits included, 25 concurrent browsers, 30-day data retention, CAPTCHA solving, basic stealth, residential proxies; extra usage billed separately.
100,000 credits included, 100 concurrent browsers, advanced stealth; extra usage billed separately.

cautions.en: Credit-based usage model (1 credit = $0.001): a browser-hour costs 100 credits, a scraped page costs 1 credit; plan credits can run out and trigger overage billing before the month renews.

capabilities.en: Cloud browser infrastructure for running headless/agentic browser sessions at scale, positioned as "web infra for AI agents".
Provides CAPTCHA solving, stealth/anti-bot evasion and residential proxies on paid plans for large-scale scraping.

limitations.en: Free plan is limited to 1 concurrent browser and a one-time 1,000-credit allotment, unsuitable for production workloads.
Pricing is usage-metered on top of a plan base, so cost is variable and depends on scraping volume rather than a flat monthly fee.

reason.en: Competing scraping-as-a-service platform aimed at feeding data to AI agents.
